name: hivelane
description: See which AI agents and teammates are editing your repo right now, and get warned before you collide.
//: TODO(owner): 'publisher' and 'repository' are suggestions; confirm the Marketplace/Open VSX publisher id and repo URL before running vsce/ovsx publish.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Hivelane sends file paths and saved diffs to the local daemon, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

hivelane.port.description: Port of the local Hivelane daemon. Folder, workspace and user settings win in that order; unset, HIVELANE_PORT from the editor's environment is used, else 4600.

hivelane.tokenPath.description: File holding the local daemon's access token. Empty: $HIVELANE_HOME/token, else ~/.hivelane/token.

hivelane.dashboardUrl.description: Base URL of the Hivelane dashboard; rooms open at <url>/r/ROOM (with ?relay= when the relay is elsewhere). Empty: $HIVELANE_DASHBOARD, else http://localhost:5173 for a local relay and https://adrianshah.github.io/Hivelane for any other.

hivelane.warnOnEdit.description: Ask the daemon before you start editing a file and warn if a peer is working on it.

hivelane.shareHumanEdits.description: Share your saved edits with the room so agents and teammates see them.

hivelane.joinApprovalRooms.description: In rooms that require an owner's approval, ask to join as a spectator so peer badges work. Off: badges stay off in those rooms and owners get no join requests from this editor. A declined request is never retried automatically.
